name: 21075-longprefill-bamba9b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One card, one in-process engine.
architecture: hybrid Mamba2 decoder (BambaForCausalLM, 9B, 32 layers, attention at layers 9/18/27 only); one ~18 GB F16 safetensors file. Full config on the checkpoint.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 8 streams, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 300 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, `request_format: plain`, fixed by construction: every request is exactly 16384 prompt tokens and exactly 64 output tokens (min=max on both), one shape repeated.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant on a 9B hybrid model, serving eight concurrent 16k-token prompts with brief answers on one GPU.
launch:
# ~18 GB in one model.safetensors. Ungated on the Hub, but NOT in the local cache -- it
# downloads on first run.
model: ibm-ai-platform/Bamba-9B-v2

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: float16
max-model-len: 20480
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384
max-num-seqs: 32
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# This checkpoint refuses to construct with prefix caching on -- `BambaForCausalLM.__init__`
# asserts "Bamba currently does not support prefix caching". Left unset it does not stay unset:
# the engine's own default for a generate model turns it ON, and the model then aborts at load.
# Nothing to hit here in any case; every prompt in this workload is distinct.
enable-prefix-caching: false
